Hi everyone - pardon the dust here on Commonwealth. This is my campaign to assign Registrar status to my account to facilitate ID verification here on Edgeware, specifically for assuring validators are who-they-say. For more info, see the full discussion:

[https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/356-registrar-campaign-thom-ivy-commonwealth-labs](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/356-registrar-campaign-thom-ivy-commonwealth-labs)
